div.style: font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; border-left: 2px solid #3572A5; padding: 4px 0 4px 14px;
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: Automation CLI that turns a song name and an artist into a finished lyrical music video — finds the track, scrapes the lyrics, times them to the audio and renders the cut.
